item.title: 'A show within a show': ACT to bring songs, laughs to the stage with musical
item.description: Albert Lea Community Theatre on Thursday will open its second show of its 60th season with the musical comedy “Nunsense,” written by Dan Goggin.

item.title: Minnesota Legislature returns with tears, roses, remembrances of Hortman
item.description: Single roses appeared Tuesday on the desk of every Minnesota House member, some of whom wore green in honor of their slain colleague and former House Speaker Melissa Hortman.

item.title: Theft by fraud and other reports
item.description: Deputies received a report at 1:12 p.m. Tuesday of a resident in Oakland who had theft by fraud on a Home Depot credit card.

item.title: Connie Faye Nelson
item.description: Connie Faye Nelson, 83, passed away at her home in Northwood, Iowa on Monday, February 16, 2026. A funeral service will be held at Bayview Freeborn Funeral Home on Monday, February 23, 2026 at 2PM with visitation to be held for an hour prior to the service.

item.title: Man sentenced to 180 days in jail, probation for hitting another man with car
item.description: A Grand Lake Township man who struck another man with his car during an altercation in December 2024 on Louis Street in Albert Lea was sentenced Tuesday in Freeborn County District Court to 180 days in the Freeborn County jail that will be spent on work release, followed by two years of probation.

item.title: 'Albert Lea is open for business': Economic development successes, opportunities from past year discussed
item.description: Business leaders celebrated the economic development successes of the last year as well as numerous projects in the works at the 80th annual Greater Jobs Inc. meeting on Wednesday at Wedgewood Cove Golf Club.

item.description: When the final traces of Minnesota winter begin to recede and the first buds appear on the oaks in Myre-Big Island State Park, the energy in Albert Lea shifts.
